cases.fact_text: A federal statute enacted by the duly authorized U.S. Congress, an instrumentality of a federal political subdivision, has the effect of law in the United States and applies to the Company's business.

A regulation issued by a duly authorized agency of a foreign country, which is a foreign political subdivision, has the effect of law in that foreign country or territory and applies to the Company or its business.
A city ordinance enacted by a duly authorized city instrumentality of a city political subdivision has the effect of law in a domestic or foreign political subdivision and applies to the Company.
A binding pronouncement issued by a duly authorized arbitrator of a state political subdivision has the effect of law in a domestic political subdivision and applies to the Company's business.
A state regulation issued by a duly authorized state commission has the effect of law in a state political subdivision and applies to the Company.
A county ordinance enacted by a duly authorized foreign county instrumentality has the effect of law in a foreign political subdivision and applies to the Company or its business.
Nonbinding guidance issued by a duly authorized federal agency has no effect of law, has no effect-of-law location, and applies to the Company.
A rule issued by a private entity that is not duly authorized, of a city political subdivision, has the effect of law in a city, and applies to the Company.
A federal statute enacted by a duly authorized U.S. Congress instrumentality has the effect of law in the United States but applies only to other companies, not to the Company or its business.
A regulation issued by a duly authorized state agency applies to the Company but lacks the effect of law and has no effect-of-law location.
An internal policy of the Company, not issued by any duly authorized governmental body, has no effect of law, has no effect-of-law location, and applies to the Company.

A binding pronouncement issued by a duly authorized arbitrator is not of any federal, state, province, county, city, or other political subdivision, has the effect of law in no listed location, and applies to the Company.

A rule issued by a private trade association, which is not a court, tribunal, arbitrator, agency, commission, official, or instrumentality, is not duly authorized, has the effect of law in the United States, and applies to the Company.
A binding pronouncement issued by a duly authorized federal court has the effect of law and applies to the Company, but the effect-of-law location is none.

cases.fact_text: A plaintiff files a breach of contract lawsuit. The matter is a lawsuit (is_lawsuit=true) and is not a claim, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

An insured submits a property damage claim under a policy. The matter is a claim (is_claim=true) and is not a lawsuit, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

An administrative agency opens a regulatory proceeding against a licensee. The matter is a proceeding (is_proceeding=true) and is not a lawsuit, claim, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

A government regulator conducts an investigation into alleged securities violations. The matter is an investigation (is_investigation=true) and is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, review, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

A manager performs an employee performance review. The matter is a review (is_review=true) and is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

An independent accountant performs a financial audit of the company. The matter is an audit (is_audit=true) and is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

A party asserts a common law cause of action for nuisance. The matter is an other cause of action (is_other_cause_of_action=true) and is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, or audit (all other listed flags are false).

A lawsuit also includes a breach of contract claim. The matter is both a lawsuit (is_lawsuit=true) and a claim (is_claim=true); it is not a proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).

An investigation includes a review of trading records. The matter is both an investigation (is_investigation=true) and a review (is_review=true); it is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, audit, or other cause of action (all other listed flags are false).
A person invites a friend to dinner. The matter is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all listed flags are false).
A band performs a concert. The matter is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all listed flags are false).
A shopper buys groceries at a supermarket. The matter is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all listed flags are false).
A meteorologist issues a weather forecast. The matter is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all listed flags are false).
An IT technician installs an operating system. The matter is not a lawsuit, claim, proceeding, investigation, review, audit, or other cause of action (all listed flags are false).

fields.source_basis: governmental or quasi-governmental authority of any nature (including any governmental agency, branch, department, official, or entity and any court or other tribunal, including an arbitral tribunal)

fields.source_basis: multi-national organization or body including the EU and notified bodies

fields.name: exercises_or_entitled_governmental_power
fields.source_basis: body exercising, or entitled to exercise, any administrative, executive, judicial, legislative, police, regulator)', or taxing power of any nature

program.rule_summary: The term is satisfied if the entity falls into any one of the five listed categories: jurisdiction of any nature; federal, state, local, municipal, or other government; governmental or quasi-governmental authority; multi-national organization or body; or a body exercising or entitled to exercise administrative, executive, judicial, legislative, police, regulator, or taxing power.

program.rule_summary: A fact is a Project if it is an undertaking, it involves the provision of services, the service type is nuclear consulting or strategic advisory, the recipient is an entity, and the recipient is in the United Arab Emirates.
